description: Humelo (휴멜로) is a Seoul-based voice AI company founded in 2018 that develops its own Korean-focused speech synthesis engines. Its PROSODY Console sells API access to the DIVE voice-cloning TTS engine and the FRTTS real-time TTS engine; DIVE and the conversational DIVE Flex can also be installed on-premises. It also runs the Sody AI phone agent and the Tikita character chat app.
name: Humelo
